name: bettracker
description: BETtracker — local betting-history analytics for bet-at-home and Stake

scripts._comment_build: Ordered, not `pnpm -r build`: the extension copies the dashboard's dist into its own, so building them in parallel packages whatever the dashboard built last time.
scripts._comment_zip_store: The upload for a web store, which is not the release download: it leaves the recorder out, because the rest of adding a bookmaker needs a checkout a store reader does not have.
scripts.zip:store: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:dashboard && pnpm --filter @betanal/extension build:store && node extension/scripts/zip.mjs
scripts._comment_postinstall: Makes har/, which git cannot carry: the folder is ignored because of what gets dropped in it, so a fresh checkout would have nowhere to save the recording.
scripts._comment_add_bookmaker: The whole flow in one command, so a contributor never has to hold the order of the steps in their head. It calls the two below rather than repeating them.
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build

_comment_overrides: Patched versions their own dependents pin too tightly to reach. Both are denial-of-service advisories in build tooling, so the exposure is a hostile file fed to our own lint or install, not anything a user runs. Drop an entry once the dependent widens its range.
